svg.title: Seminar room 2.14, week nine, 11.52
svg.desc: A humanities building with a seminar room, a clock at 11.52, a half-raised hand, a propped door and a tutor with a tally sheet.

g.text: Twelve things to find. Four belong to the person speaking. Four belong to the people who are not.
the corridor, and a door propped open
the library, and the unfinished reading
the faculty office, committee twice a year
a phone face down, a coffee gone cold
